 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz 'PBB Collab 3.0': Jeo Ong explains why he's been keeping his distance from Shea Valerio 
 By GMA News Published November 14, 2026 11:47am 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB Jeo Ong explained why he has been keeping his distance from Shea Valerio after the latter noticed a sudden change in his behavior inside the “Pinoy Big Brother Collab Edition 3.0” house.
 On Friday’s episode, Shea opened up to the other female housemates about how Jeo has seemingly started avoiding her, saying Jeo no longer greeted her good morning, smiled at her, or made eye contact.
 She recalled that they were still on good terms when she offered Jeo a bite of food, but noticed that he became distant afterward.
 Cianne Dominguez then approached Jeo to ask about his behavior toward Shea.

 Jeo explained that he decided to keep a little distance after the other male housemates teased him about Shea feeding him. He also learned about Shea's admiration for him, which caught him off guard.
 “Primo [Alterado] and Robbie [Jaworski] were teasing me. Now, even when you're simply being kind to someone, people tend to misinterpret it,” Jeo said.
 He clarified that he sees his relationships with the housemates as platonic and wants to maintain the same treatment toward everyone.
 After speaking with Jeo, Cianne relayed his explanation to Shea and the other girls, saying that Jeo wanted to avoid creating awkwardness or giving the wrong impression.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on October 24. Sixteen housemates, composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
 The series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —Carby Rose Basina/JCB, GMA News
